This is a maraging steel of the 18Ni(350) type, with Ni 18.1, Co 13, Mo 3.5 and Ti 1.62. I estimated the yield strength from what I remember of that grade rather than looking up the dataset row. Maraging steels of this type typically reach about 2300–2500 MPa, and the matbench_steels entries for this grade are usually around 2400 MPa. I'm giving 2410 MPa as an estimate, not a confirmed recorded value.

{"yield_mpa": 2410}
